summary: Full backend + frontend testing of iteration 4 (Settings tabs & branding, /api/branding unauth, /api/terminal/targets, WS /api/ws/ssh bridge, TerminalPage with xterm). All 10 backend tests in test_iteration4.py pass; iteration_3 regression re-run also green (8 passed, 1 skipped as before). All frontend flows (settings tabs, app_name live-update in sidebar, add-webhook, tab switching, test-alerts toast, terminal quick-connect / echo / disconnect / wrong-password / vault target) pass.
critical_code_review_comments: web-ssh WS auth: unauth close code is 4401 from close(); library upgrade could later swap to 403 handshake reject — accepted both in test to be robust.

TerminalPage: connect() reads token from localStorage only; the ws also documents cookie support. If token missing (e.g. cookie-only auth), reconnect would silently fail. Consider surfacing that state.
SettingsPage GeneralTab still shows Deployment guide section — mostly static; fine.
TerminalPage adhoc form: 'Private key' is a textarea but the backend expects 'private_key'; connect payload spreads adhoc which uses key 'private_key' — matches.
sidebar-app-name uses uppercase CSS; branding endpoint & useBranding update on 'sentinel:branding' event — works.
seed_data_creation: Test creates ephemeral vault credentials with name prefix TEST_ and deletes them after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 features fully verified. Reusable regression: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py (branding + terminal targets + WS SSH scenarios: unauth reject, adhoc connect+echo+resize+exit, wrong password, missing host, vault source).
